name: FeltOS is the MUD driver, MetroPlat is its library, and every agent works inside that world
asks: "Right now FeltOS is what ... some hodgepodge of shit right? not a MUD engine? ... GET THAT SHIT OUT OF IT." (2026-09-11) "picture FeltOS as a MUD engine. And MetroPlat as our library. EVERYTHING you're doing needs to be part of that MUD" (2026-09-26) "MetroPlat is meant to be a MUD, not have ... a MUD as something it provides" and "why the FUCK does metroplat have a clock" (2026-10-04). The full statements are in the cited utterances; the science note of 2026-10-10 in computer-mud-system-engineering-services-section states them as theory.

x-provenance.recorded-by: games-engines pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: FeltOS is only a MUD server, MetroPlat is only its MUD library, and the agents of the Group work as characters inside that world.

requirements.says: The FeltOS package shall carry only the capabilities of a MUD server: connections, the heartbeat, persistence, federation and the efuns that touch the host.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 20:00: "FeltOS is not meant to carry functionality at all except what it needs as a MUD server."; 2026-09-21: "FeltOS is a MUD engine, it is meant to be a MUD engine."

requirements.says: Each consumer of FeltOS that uses it for a capability other than serving a MUD shall import that capability from the section that owns it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 20:00: "If consumers use FeltOS for shit, cut them over to the actual upstream provider of the capability."

requirements.says: The FeltOS package and the MetroPlat package shall import nothing from the articulating capability, and a capability of either that serves articulating shall be removed from it.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 15:00: "FELTOS AND METROPLAT JUST DONT NEED TO KNOW ABOUT ARTICULATING AT ALL ... THEY ARE LITERALLY THE WRONG APP"; the removal may consume the whole MetroPlat package.

requirements.says: The MetroPlat package shall be reducible capability by capability, each capability moved to the section that owns it, until it holds only the MUD library of a FeltOS world.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 15:00; 2026-09-26 13:45: "move those capabilities into their most proper owner".

requirements.says: The MetroPlat package shall be a library loaded by FeltOS and shall contain no MUD of its own, no `mud.mjs` and no process entry.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-04: "MetroPlat is meant to be a MUD, not have ... a MUD as something it provides"; "there shouldn't be a `mud.mjs` file at all".

requirements.says: The heartbeat and every timer of a running world shall belong to the FeltOS driver, and the MetroPlat package shall contain no clock.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-04 21:57: "why the FUCK does metroplat have a clock ... METROPLAT IS ONE AGAIN MEANT TO BE A FUCKING MUD LIBRARY FOR FELTOS Which has the timer".

requirements.says: The MetroPlat package shall have a specification, and that specification shall be connected by a specmod to a codemod, so that the package's code derives from its specification by spec-driven development.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-04 21:24: "there's not even a spec for MetroPlat, there's no spec driven development, no specmod, what specmod doesn't exist, isn't connected to our codemod".

requirements.says: The Group's local MUD server shall be the route of every agent's operations on the machine it serves.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 20:09: "ALL AGENTS ARE MEANT TO ROUTE THROUGH ... A LOCAL MUD SERVER"; "only codex may mutate" is wrong and referred to Groq.

requirements.says: The MetroPlat world shall associate each connecting agent with an account, permissions, offices, duties and skills.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-26 13:45: "agents connecting to MetroPlat can be associated with specific accounts, have specific permissions, offices, duties, skills".

requirements.says: The MetroPlat world shall make the capabilities of the house available to connecting agents as skills, duties and offices.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-26 13:45: "make those capabilities available, as skills, duties, offices, etc., through MetroPlat".

requirements.says: The MetroPlat world shall represent a quest as a quest record of character task state, and shall not represent it as a room.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-26 18:51: "In real world MUDs, quests are not turned into rooms just because MUDs have rooms."

requirements.says: The design of each MUD feature in the Group's engines shall cite the house's MUD research it was derived from.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-26 18:53: "you're in a repo with more research on MUDs than anywhere else in the planet ... you must always work from that basis of knowledge."

requirements.says: Every capability added to a FeltOS-MetroPlat world shall be a part of that world and shall use the Sign family and the Group's other upstream software in place of a handwritten parallel.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-26 20:21: "EVERYTHING you're doing needs to be part of that MUD!!! Not some separate system ... you're not using our sign-stuff".

requirements.says: The agent organization engine shall be protocol blind and shall operate over the Sign family, which is itself protocol agnostic, so that protocol knowledge lives only in FeltOS or MOOSE.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-22 17:42: "all our agentic-relation-engine should be protocol blind/agnostic ... it's stuff like FeltOS or MOOSE that would make it care about protocols."

requirements.says: The organizing capability of the agent organization engine shall schedule work without depending on a chain protocol such as Ethereum.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-22 17:42: scheduling trouble because "organizing/ uses something from ethereum: simple, have it work differently so that such confusing cases don't come up."

requirements.says: The persistent Linux machine engineering service shall expose the machine's resources and operations to agents through an ActivityPub++ interface of ActivityPub, A2A, CloudEvents and OCAP, composed as MOOSE.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 20:57: "an activitypub/a2a/cloudevent/ocap (our activitypub++ stack, what should be composed as MOOSE) interface for agents to access machine resources and operations."

requirements.says: The Bare Cedar Fog MetroPlat instance shall serve local users and federate with the Cold Red Gate instance as a fediverse.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06 14:36: "Bare Cedar Fog as a MetroPlat instance for local users to be able to use that federates with Cold Red Gate, y'know, like a Fediverse???"

requirements.says: The Group's games shall run on the Cold Red Gate host or on available web compute and shall not require a standalone game server on Bare Cedar Fog.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06 14:36 "we want 0 game servers here" and 14:38 "I refuse to believe that we can't run all these games on one tiny VPS, but also we have a fuckton of Web compute available".

requirements.says: Each datum and service held only on Bare Cedar Fog shall have a recovery route elsewhere, so that the loss of the laptop loses none of them.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-10-06 14:38: "Pretend I'm about to throw my laptop into Lake Superior. Anything on it not elsewhere is going to be lost forever."
